Amazing Pet Shop, I have been visiting this shop over many years & it has everything you could want in a Pet Shop, very small inside, staff are so helpful👏🏆.
Dog prams, beds, Naturo Dog food, Pet tags for dog collars, etc etc.
Long may this shop continue here.
👩‍🦳🐶🐶 …

Today I walked into this store and left feeling deeply upset. They have a small parrot confined to a cage and displayed as if it were just another product. I don’t understand how this can be legal.

It breaks my heart that some people still believe animals don’t deserve freedom and a life with dignity. I will never shop here again, and I hope anyone who truly cares about animal welfare will think twice before supporting this business. Keeping a living, intelligent animal confined and on display like this is exploitation, not care.

I popped in a couple of days ago to pick up a few bits and bobs to make my void baby’s 10-month kittenversary special. Browsed about and found a wand toy which I knew my cat would love. I was not mistaken. My void girl goes absolutely bananas for this toy, as seen in the image below (yes, voids are meant to be blurry shadows, it’s cat law!).

Anyways, the staff were super nice, friendly and really helpful which is always nice. You can tell the folx working there love animals, which is even better. Makes for a better shopping experience.
